changes.release_notes:
What to wear? Already sorted.
Planner now suggests outfits based on your wardrobe and the weather, so getting dressed feels easier. You can also plan ahead for trips, weekends and events by changing your location.

- New Packing: manage the clothes, outfits, and even items not in your closet for your trip in one place, and get outfit recommendations based on your packed clothes and destination weather.
- Set your own high and low temperatures from the Home or outfit recommendation screen to get outfits that fit the occasion.
- Outfit and daily look dates now show the year and day of the week more clearly.
- Find items with no value assigned in your closet and outfit book using the "Not set" filter.

Finally here: sort your items and outfits by Most and Least Recently Worn — so you always know what you've been reaching for, and what's been quietly waiting. Both views are also now woven into your Dashboard.

Also new: a weekly calendar view on the Today tab to see your full week of outfits at a glance. And Refine — write a quick prompt on any Enhanced image and we'll take it exactly where you want it.
